facts.fact: Biometric Update reports that a BUNEC working session with Liber Technologies in Yaounde in October 2025 named connecting the civil registration centres, whose principal centres sit in councils, among the challenges facing the reform; no count of centres connected is given.

systems.owner: BUNEC, the National Civil Status Registration Office
systems.tiers: computerisation extended to 60 principal civil registration centres of 432 (49 of them in diplomatic missions and consulates), per BUNEC's director general; piloted from 2022 in centres of some councils in Yaounde; digital registration runs only in selected councils beside the dominant paper process; 2,439 secondary and 149 special centres also exist
named as a challenge in October 2025; no centre stated as connected

systems.system: digital master plan for local and regional councils
systems.owner: Ministry of Decentralization and Local Development
systems.tiers: local and regional councils; being implemented

systems.system: inter-administrative platform linking civil registration and national ID
systems.owner: BUNEC, with the General Delegation for National Security

note: The 60 computerised centres are stated as computerised, not as connected, and belong to the civil registration application; the one fact is the October 2025 statement that connecting the centres remains a challenge.
